outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity across nuclear/cytoplasmic compartments and genotypes, but no individual data points (dots) are overlaid despite n>100 cells being sampled.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells for N=4 mice per genotype, but individual data points for the 4 mice are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot tracking rotarod performance over weeks; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay as this would make the plot unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots showing rotarod performance across days at different weeks; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (a line/step plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel G shows immunofluorescence micrographs with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) showing mean ± SD for nine mice per group (N=3, n=9), but individual data points are not overlaid on the bars.
